messages:
Priya Patel: incident-bot paged the on-call: high 5xx and node health anomalies in eu-west-1 inference pool. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PAGER: service=inference-prod region=eu-west-1 symptom=node_not_ready>=3 over 6m; error_rate x4.1; severity=high; see runbooks/infra/kube-node-flap.md
Priya Patel: Investigating cluster inference-eu-west-1 now.
Alex Kim: Jumping in to look at node status; any customer reports yet?
Riley Chen: Partial; a few tenants seeing increased 504s and RTT spikes. No full-tenant outage reported.
Priya Patel: kubectl shows multiple nodes NotReady; pods on them are OOMKilled, CrashLoopBackOff or Evicted.
Alex Kim: sample describe from gpu-node-07:
```
Kubelet: CrashLoopBackOff
Reason: KubeletStoppedPosting
Kernel log: nv_peer_mem: firmware missing; nvidia: failed to init
```
Riley Chen: Kubelet logs show device-plugin segfaults repeatedly leading to kubelet restart.
Priya Patel: Hypothesis: bad GPU driver in latest node image triggers device-plugin failures -> kubelet instability -> nodes NotReady -> pod evictions -> capacity pressure and latency.
Jordan O'Neill: Coordinator: focus on (1) user-facing continuity, (2) stop churn, (3) restore stable GPU capacity.
Alex Kim: Triage plan: cordon flaky gpu nodes, spin up extra CPU-backed nodes for fallbacks, enable gateway variant-fallback to another region if possible.
Priya Patel: Running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-05 gpu-node-07 gpu-node-11 gpu-node-13`.
deploy-bot: autoscaler request accepted: +5 cpu-large nodes to inference-eu-west-1-autoscale-group
Riley Chen: Pushing route fallback so requests can hit cpu-fallback-pool or eu-central-1. This will increase latency but keeps requests succeeding.
Priya Patel: Patching gateway:
```
PATCH /api/routes/inference-prod
{ "fallback": { "priority": ["eu-west-1-cpu","eu-central-1"], "allow_variant_fallback": true } }
```
Alex Kim: Found recent infra image rollout at 23:41 UTC which bumped nvidia driver package to 536.x. Kern logs show oopses at allocation time; reproduced on 2 nodes.
Priya Patel: Initiating rolling-replace to previous stable image and pausing further image rollouts.
Alex Kim: Kicking off replace: `gcloud ... rolling-action replace --instance-group=gpu-ig-euw --versions=v2026-03-10-stable` (started)
deploy-bot: rolling-replace job rr-2026-0316-01 started
Riley Chen: Alerting support and updating #customer-impact with current mitigation and ETA. Message posted: "Degraded inference in eu-west-1 due to node health. Fallback routing and extra capacity applied. Working on rolling replace; next update in 15m."
Priya Patel: Collected dmesg and device-plugin core dumps; uploading to infra bucket and linking in ticket.
Alex Kim: After two replaced nodes came back Ready, device-plugin stabilized there and pods scheduled normally. Error rate down from 4.1x to ~1.2x.
Priya Patel: Replaced remaining flaky nodes; all nodes Ready, kubelet uptime >10m. Re-enabled GPU taints and let pods reschedule.
Riley Chen: Removed route-fallback and scaled down CPU nodes. Customer update: "Incident mitigated; root cause was bad GPU driver in image. We're adding extra smoke tests to image pipeline and pausing automatic driver upgrades."
Jordan O'Neill: Post-incident actions assigned:
- Alex Kim: block faulty image in image registry, add rollback hooks to deployment pipeline.
- Priya Patel: add device-plugin preflight check to node bootstrap and adjust noisy kubelet alerts.
- Riley Chen: prepare status page entry and customer FAQ.
- Jordan O'Neill: draft postmortem and schedule blameless review.
Priya Patel: Incident declared mitigated. Duration ~39m. Summary: GPU driver image caused device-plugin crashes and kubelet restarts -> node NotReady -> degraded inference. Rolling replace to stable image restored nodes and full capacity.
incident-bot: incident status=mitigated; duration=39m; incident_id=INC-2026-0316-14
Jordan O'Neill: Great work, team. I'll keep the postmortem task and follow-ups tracked. :pray:
Riley Chen: I'll drop the postmortem link here once created.
Priya Patel: Leaving follow-ups in infra backlog. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
